card.name: Comma after 'prior to administration' inspection
card.fires_on: The comma right after 'prior to administration' in the sentence about visually inspecting parenteral products for particulate matter and discoloration. It also fires on a comma in a list of time points after mixing.

modes.label: Inspection sentence comma
modes.description: Comma after 'prior to administration' just before 'whenever solution and container permit'.
modes.example: Parenteral drug products should be inspected visually for particulate matter and discoloration prior to administration<<,>> whenever solution and container permit.

modes.label: Time-point list comma
modes.description: Comma after a number in a list of time points in a mixing study.
modes.example: products in a 1:1 volume ratio at room temperature was evaluated by visual inspection, and measurement of turbidity and particulate matter at 0<<,>> 1 and 4 hours after mixing

card.plain: It marks the comma in the standard line about checking injectable products for particles and colour change before use.
